spec.name: Blend v36
spec.notes: Blend of trend, earnings surprise and a volatility penalty.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.4, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 9%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits significant selection bias, as the research log indicates it was chosen from a small set of trials without rigorous out-of-sample validation. Furthermore, the backtest uses the entire available dataset (end: null), which risks overfitting to the full historical period. While the signal components are theoretically sound, the lack of a dedicated out-of-sample test period makes the claimed Sharpe ratio of 2.4 unreliable. Given the lack of rigorous validation and the potential for data snooping, I recommend paper trading to verify performance stability before committing real capital.
